research.job_description_summary: Qualcomm hires engineers in India (Hyderabad, Bengaluru) for software, embedded and validation roles. A May 2026 Glassdoor review describes an online assessment (aptitude 20, maths 20, programming 20), a first technical round on OS and DSA (process versus thread), a second technical round on low-level C/C++, OOP, a HackerRank DSA problem and a bit-flip question, and an HR round. A 2026 hiring post lists C, OS and DSA. The official careers page was not fetched.
limitations: Qualcomm's official careers page was not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED.

Candidate-attributed material is essentially one Glassdoor review (May 2026; exact day not captured, recorded as the 1st of the month); only process versus thread and the bit-flip question are reported as questions, so only 2 items carry class B and are unverified.
The freshershunt hiring post is undated in the capture (recorded as 2026-01-01 as a placeholder) and gives topics only.
An older LeetCode Discuss post and 2015/2024 Jointaro experiences were seen but are outside the recency window and used only as context.
The Validation Engineer track is inferred from the review's mention of validation, VLSI, digital electronics and C topics; its content is original practice.
Aptitude and maths items are original practice; section sizes come from the single review.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
Source pages on LeetCode Discuss and Glassdoor returned HTTP 403 to the CodeArena audit tool (2026-10-11), so the cited questions were not re-confirmed against those pages.

questions.prompt: Explain how a CMOS inverter works and why it has low static power.
questions.relevance_to_role: A May 2026 Glassdoor review describes a first technical round on OS (process versus thread) and data structures; a 2026 hiring post lists C, OS and DSA.
questions.expected_answer: PMOS pulls up when input is low; NMOS pulls down when high. Only one conducts at steady state, so there is no direct VDD-to-ground path apart from leakage.
follow_ups: Where does dynamic power come from?
questions.notes: VLSI is a reported topic; this item is an original practice question. Topic context only (no candidate attribution): https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Interview/Qualcomm-Interview-E640-RVW81941403.htm.

questions.prompt: What are setup and hold times and what happens if they are violated?
questions.relevance_to_role: A May 2026 Glassdoor review describes a first technical round on OS (process versus thread) and data structures; a 2026 hiring post lists C, OS and DSA.
questions.expected_answer: Setup is how long data must be stable before the clock edge; hold is how long after. Violations cause metastability or wrong capture; fix setup by slowing the clock or pipelining, hold by adding delay.
follow_ups: How do you fix a hold violation?
common_mistakes: Fixing hold by slowing the clock
questions.notes: VLSI is a reported topic; this item is an original practice question. Topic context only (no candidate attribution): https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Interview/Qualcomm-Interview-E640-RVW81941403.htm.

questions.prompt: Differentiate combinational and sequential circuits with examples.
questions.relevance_to_role: A May 2026 Glassdoor review describes a first technical round on OS (process versus thread) and data structures; a 2026 hiring post lists C, OS and DSA.
questions.expected_answer: Combinational output depends only on current inputs (adders, muxes); sequential depends on state and clock (counters, registers, FSMs).
questions.notes: Digital electronics is a reported topic; this item is an original practice question. Topic context only (no candidate attribution): https://www.glassdoor.co.in/Interview/Qualcomm-Interview-E640-RVW81941403.htm.

questions.relevance_to_role: A May 2026 Glassdoor review describes a first technical round on OS (process versus thread) and data structures; a 2026 hiring post lists C, OS and DSA.
questions.expected_answer: Moore output depends only on state; Mealy on state and input, so it often needs fewer states and reacts a cycle sooner but can glitch.

questions.prompt: What is metastability and how do synchronisers reduce it?
questions.relevance_to_role: A May 2026 Glassdoor review describes a first technical round on OS (process versus thread) and data structures; a 2026 hiring post lists C, OS and DSA.
questions.expected_answer: A flip-flop sampling during its setup/hold window can settle slowly to an undefined level. A two-flop synchroniser gives time to resolve before the value is used.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between verification and validation in a chip flow?
questions.relevance_to_role: A May 2026 Glassdoor review describes a second technical round on low-level C/C++, OOP, a HackerRank DSA problem and a bit-flip question.
questions.expected_answer: Verification checks the design meets its spec (simulation, formal); validation checks the real silicon behaves correctly in the system.
